name: Fansipan
kicker: Cable car to the 3,143 m summit
summary: Cable car to the 3,143 m summit: ride 15–30 minutes, then the pagoda, for the ridge above town. Go when the ridge is clear. Weather can close the line. Ride times in print are about 15 minutes, 15–20 minutes, and 30 minutes. An out-of-province adult is 750,000 đồng on the 2018 page and 850,000 đồng round trip in the 2026 guide.
timeNeeded: Check on arrival for a full visit
fee: Check on arrival. 750,000 đồng on the 2018 page, or 850,000 đồng in the 2026 guide.
getThere: Taxi or the Muong Hoa funicular to Hoang Lien station. Minutes from the church are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The summit platform, the stairs, and the flag above the cloud

notice.title: The cable ticket is one charge
notice.body: A scenic fee from 1 January 2025 is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Pay it beside the cable ticket. The funicular and the summit train are extra, and their prices are posted at the station.

body: The summit is 3,143 m on the national pages and the operator pages. You ride the cable car from Nguyễn Chí Thanh, then walk the pagoda and the last steps, or take a separate summit train. The old walk is described as two days, or as two to three days in one search extract. The cable ride itself is about 15 minutes on Vietnam Tourism and on the 2018 operator page, 15–20 minutes in the 2026 guide, and 30 minutes in a VNAT extract whose page returned an error. Keep all three.

Keep both adult prices. The operator page dated 20 August 2018 shows 750,000 đồng for an out-of-province adult and for a child over 1.4 m, 550,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m, and under 1 m free. Lao Cai residents are 550,000, 350,000, and free with papers. The 2026 guide prints an out-of-province round trip at 850,000 đồng for an adult, 550,000 đồng for a child from 1 m to under 1.4 m, and under 1 m free, and it says prices change.

The clocks disagree too. Vietnam Tourism prints 7:30am–5:30pm every day. The operator homepage prints 07:30–17:00 and says hours may change. A notice of 28 September 2026, after maintenance above 3,000 m, sets Monday–Thursday departures 8:00–14:30 with last return 16:00, Friday 8:00–15:30 with last return 17:00, Saturday 7:30–15:30 with last return 17:00, and Sunday 7:30–14:30 with last return 16:00. Read the board that morning.

figures.caption: A cabin over the terraces on the way up
figures.alt: A yellow and black Fansipan cable-car cabin above green rice terraces

gettingThere: Sun World’s address is Đường Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Sa Pa. Go by taxi or by the Muong Hoa funicular from Sun Plaza to Hoang Lien station. The funicular is about five minutes, with two tunnels and four viaducts, and it is sold on its own. The fare is at the station. A published minute count from the church is missing. One national extract places the mountain 9 km southwest of the town. Use that only as a rough bearing.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Taxi or the funicular toward Hoang Lien station on Nguyễn Chí Thanh. A published minute count is missing.

legs.heading: On foot, a different trip
legs.body: The national park names three walking routes. Trạm Tôn is about 10.5 km, one day or two days and one night, the route most people use. Sín Chải is about 18 km over three days. Cát Cát is more than 12 km over three days. A trek price is posted with the park, separate from the cable ticket.

hours: Vietnam Tourism: 7:30am–5:30pm every day. Operator homepage: 07:30–17:00, and hours may change. Notice of 28 September 2026: Monday–Thursday departures 8:00–14:30, last return 16:00; Friday 8:00–15:30, last return 17:00; Saturday 7:30–15:30, last return 17:00; Sunday 7:30–14:30, last return 16:00.
closed: Weather may close the line. Check the operator that morning.
admissionNote: Out-of-province adult: 750,000 đồng on the operator page dated 20 August 2018, and 850,000 đồng round trip in the 2026 guide. Child about 1 m to 1.4 m: 550,000 đồng on both of those pages. Under 1 m: free. The 2018 page also prints Lao Cai residents at 550,000 / 350,000 / free with papers. A scenic fee from 1 January 2025, decision 4640, is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Pay it beside the cable ticket. Cable length is about 6 km on Vietnam Tourism and 6,292.5 m on the operator page. Both lengths stay.
